categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of micro-nano direct write lithography equipment and direct imaging equipment, primarily serving the PCB and general semiconductor sectors. Its product portfolio includes PCB direct imaging equipment and automated lines, general semiconductor direct write lithography equipment and automated lines, laser direct imaging equipment, and related after-sales maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include micro-nano direct write lithography, laser direct imaging (LDI), multi-axis precision control, ultraviolet optical systems, real-time autofocus algorithms, multi-beam parallel scanning, ECC error correction, and high-precision pattern processing. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) and platform-based modular development, with advanced manufacturing processes emphasizing high precision, stability, and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading PCB manufacturers and semiconductor companies, including top-tier PCB firms like Pengding Holdings, Huidian, Shenghong Technology, and semiconductor packaging and testing companies. The company serves markets related to AI servers, automotive electronics, advanced packaging, IC substrates, mask making, new display technologies (OLED, Mini/Micro-LED), and power semiconductors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province. The company has expanded its international footprint with subsidiaries in Suzhou and Thailand, targeting Southeast Asia markets such as Thailand and Vietnam, and has established strategic partnerships in Japan and South Korea. It also serves global markets through exports and overseas collaborations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and PCB supply chain, providing critical lithography equipment and solutions used in the manufacturing and packaging processes of PCBs, IC substrates, semiconductor chips, and advanced packaging. It also offers after-sales maintenance services, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier within the manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end PCB equipment, accelerating international expansion especially in Southeast Asia, deepening penetration in advanced semiconductor packaging, and developing new products for emerging fields like third-generation semiconductors and new display technologies. The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, IPD system enhancement, talent acquisition, and collaboration with academic and research institutions to maintain technological leadership and support domestic substitution of imported equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithography and imaging equipment to PCB and semiconductor manufacturers. The company also earns income from after-sales maintenance services and equipment leasing. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales complemented by distributor channels, with contracts including outright sales and trial agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider of direct write lithography equipment, competing against international giants from Europe, Japan, and Israel such as Heidelberg, Orbotech, and ORC. It holds a strong market position in China with growing international presence, leveraging technological innovation, cost-effectiveness, and localized service advantages to challenge established foreign competitors and accelerate domestic substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 953.9 million, a 15.09% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 160.7 million, a slight decrease of 10.38%. Total assets grew by 12.43% to RMB 2.79 billion, and net assets increased by 1.52% to RMB 2.06 billion. The company maintains steady growth driven by PCB business expansion and international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, stability, and cost-effectiveness of its direct write lithography equipment, with advanced features such as minimum line widths of 3-4 microns, multi-beam parallel scanning, and intelligent process control. Its localized service network enables rapid response and support, providing a competitive edge over foreign suppliers. The company’s integrated product platforms and continuous innovation enable it to meet diverse customer needs across PCB, semiconductor packaging, mask making, and new display technologies, supporting domestic substitution and global competitiveness.
